correctness.rationale: TARGET route: draft sketches rather than proves the headline. Step 1 asserts uniform F_K->ln(4g rho) with quenched constant 1/4 via an unverified c0=-ln2 Laplace claim; the only verification is numeric integral 1.5509~=pi/2, not an operator estimate. Step 2 applies IFT to F_K=min_s[phi_K+lnK], which need not be C1, with no K-uniform Lipschitz proof. Steps 4-5 assert uniform fractional-moment decay and Simon-Wolff/Klein purity upgrade from sign(F_K) without estimates. Crucially, Aizenman-Warzel resonant-delocalization as cited does not apply to C1_c compact support as stated: Aggarwal-Lopatto full text says compact version needs additional technicalities. Draft's own cavity_refine diagnostics place empirical zero at 0.74-0.76 (bare 0.745) not target 0.696, so computation does not certify the constant.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors are Bapst 2014 (local large-K threshold gc=1/(4 rho(E)) with per-energy neighborhoods, no finite edge bijection) and Aggarwal-Lopatto 2025 Theorem 1.3 (full finite mobility-edge classification with same scaling t=g/(K lnK), threshold rho=1/(4g) and slope rule, but explicitly for L-regular everywhere-positive unbounded densities). Full-text inspection shows Aggarwal-Lopatto Definition 1.1(4) requires inf_{|x|<v}rho>0 and states compact-support criterion would need extra technicalities, so compactly supported C1_c global classification with bijection and purity is not recorded verbatim nor mechanically implied by either prior.

value.rationale: If proved, a sharp finite mobility-edge classification on the Bethe lattice at large degree for natural compactly supported disorder, pinpointing edges near rho=1/(4g) with slope-rule ac vs exponentially dynamically localized phases, would confirm the Abou-Chacra-Thouless-Anderson prediction in the bounded-disorder regime. It is a new theorem over a motivated object and invariant, not a textbook restatement, mere parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration under the shared STANDARD.
